Common Questions

Before you order

Is aluminium priced per kilogram or per foot?
In Pakistan's trade, aluminium sections are priced per running foot from the brand rate list (Prime / Pak Alumex), by section, thickness and finish. Send us your sizes and we will quote on that same transparent basis.
Which brands do you supply — and is the material genuine?
We are the Authorised Dealer of Prime Aluminium Industries and the Sole Distributor Karachi for Pak Alumex. Material comes through authorised mill channels only, in original packing.
What thicknesses and finishes are available?
Sections are available in gauges from 0.9mm up to 2.0mm depending on the series, in Champagne, Black Matt, Black Powder Coating, Dull, Wood textures (9161-S, 9135-M), RAL 9016 White, Grey and more.
How do I get an estimate without visiting the shop?
Photograph your handwritten measurement slip and send it on WhatsApp to 0332-2418106 — or use the calculator and quote form on this page. You will receive a proper written estimate bill.
Do you deliver outside Karachi?
Yes. Along with Karachi delivery, we regularly dispatch material by bilty across Pakistan — including Khuzdar, Gwadar, Hyderabad, Dadu and Mirpurkhas. Carriage is added at actuals and shown on your bill.
